_comment: Verified CC0 / no-attribution-required audio tracks for long-form (ambient/phonk) and short-form (swap-in for reused clips). Agent 4.2 and Agent 3.1 only pull from entries where verified=true. verification_note must state what was checked (license tag AND source page), not just the platform label. Energy tiering added 2026-08-04 (owner direction: long-form audio was reading too upbeat for the quiet-luxury aesthetic) -- every track now carries an energy_profile (beat_strength/rms via librosa, tier: ambient_quiet/calm_lofi/upbeat_rhythmic). Only Wetlands genuinely measures ambient_quiet as of 2026-08-04; searched FMA further the same day (HoliznaCC0 Ocean Memory album tracks measured upbeat_rhythmic/calm_lofi, blv8ion Cloud Stillness/Innerwave albums are genuinely ambient by ear/title but licensed CC-BY-NC-ND -- non-commercial-only, rejected) -- see agents/long_form/4.2_sound_sourcer.md for the full method and thresholds. Future sourcing should keep looking for more ambient_quiet options; do not default to calm_lofi/upbeat_rhythmic out of convenience. 2026-08-04 update: owner supplied a real reference clip (a competitor SansSylvna Short) and the energy tiering was recalibrated against its measured beat_strength=0.508 (see agents/long_form/4.2_sound_sourcer.md). Two new genuinely ambient_quiet tracks added (Cosmic Waves, Too Brief a Time to be Anything, both HoliznaCC0 Space-Sleep-Meditation album) plus Rain _ Sleep _ Meditation reclassified from calm_lofi to ambient_quiet under the corrected threshold -- 3 real ambient options now vs. 1 before. The reference clip itself is never used in any production (competitor copyrighted audio) -- calibration target only.

tracks.title: Phonk ish
tracks.verification_note: Checked the license badge/link on the track's own FMA page (not a third-party aggregator claim): rel="license" anchor points directly to https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. Also confirmed via the site's own download-overlay modal (https://freemusicarchive.org/track/phonk-ish/downloadOverlay/) which explicitly states 'CC0/Public Domain' for this track. Direct file download via the standard /track/<slug>/download/ route requires an FMA login (302 to /login when unauthenticated), so the file was instead fetched from the same-page embedded data-track-info JSON's public 'fileUrl' field, which points to FMA's own CDN (files.freemusicarchive.org) and required no authentication. Downloaded file verified via `file` and `ffprobe`: real MPEG audio, 320kbps, 48kHz stereo, 145.56s duration, non-corrupt, non-zero size (5,823,523 bytes). Stylistic match note: FMA has no literal 'phonk' genre-CC0 catalog beyond this artist; HoliznaCC0 is a netlabel-style artist who explicitly self-releases all work as CC0 and this track is genre-tagged/titled 'Phonk ish' under album 'PHONK - AURA FARMING', a genuine bass-driven electronic instrumental — closest real CC0 match found to the requested slowed hardtekk/phonk direction (no lyrics, no recognizable sample).
